mettle.feedback.stealth.coward: Coward's Edge · caught in the open
mettle.perk.stealth.ambusher.description: Sneak attacks on a mob that isn't targeting you deal 30%% more.
mettle.perk.stealth.assassin.description: Your first sneak attack on a mob that hasn't seen you deals triple damage (a boss: half again).
mettle.perk.stealth.cloak_of_dusk.descri: In light 7 or less, hostiles notice you at 75%% of their range, and Hearth's witnesses see you 25%% nearer.
mettle.perk.stealth.footpad.description: Climbing and swimming make no sound and keep sneaking's cover.
mettle.perk.stealth.ghost.description: Sneaking in light 7 or less and not attacking, hostiles beyond 4 blocks can't see you at all, and neither can Hearth's witnesses.
mettle.perk.stealth.hamstring.descriptio: A sneak attack slows its target by half for 3 s.
mettle.perk.stealth.never_seen.descripti: Mobs that lose you forget you twice as fast.
mettle.perk.stealth.night_hunter.descrip: Arrows you loose while sneaking at a mob that isn't targeting you always crit.
mettle.perk.stealth.poisoner.description: Sneak attacks with a blade poison the target for 3 s.
mettle.perk.stealth.quiet_feet.descripti: Your sneaking steps and landings make no vibration for sculk sensors and shriekers.
mettle.perk.stealth.shadow.description: While you sneak, hostiles notice you at %s%% of their range, and your Stealth counts higher with Hearth folk (1 / 2 / 3).
mettle.perk.stealth.shadowstep.descripti: Sneak-jump at a mob within 8 blocks that isn't targeting you to step behind it (12 s cooldown; never at a player; walls stop it).
mettle.perk.stealth.silent_fall.descript: Falls while sneaking make no vibration and land 2 blocks softer.
mettle.perk.stealth.the_quiet_way.descri: Hearth's witnesses see you 10%% nearer, and a guard who loses sight of you gives up a third sooner.
mettle.perk.stealth.the_quiet_way.hint: Taught by a city's fence, or found in The Nightwalker's Book.
mettle.perk.stealth.under_its_nose.descr: Darkness lasts half as long on you.
mettle.perk.stealth.under_its_nose.hint: It listened. It did not hear.
mettle.perk.stealth.unseen_blade.descrip: A sneak attack that no other mob saw alerts nothing within 8 blocks.
mettle.perk.stealth.vanish.description: Sneak for 2 s out of a hostile's sight: it loses you at once (30 s cooldown).
